prompt: Close on a carved stone wall lit by a raised lantern, a long relief of small robed dwarven figures carrying something large and bound in chains, the carving deliberate and repetitive, moss and dust in the grooves
motion: The lantern light travels slowly along the relief from left to right, revealing more figures and more chain.
say: The walls told the story, in the way that walls do, which is to say proudly and without any of the useful details.
sfx: A lantern creaking, a hand brushing dust from stone, echoing drips
